title: Signed virtual-tape step
statement: For Boolean flags $\mathit{dbl},\mathit{last},\mathit{first},\mathit{par},\mathit{dir},\mathit{isChar}$ and a natural-number counter $s$, define a transition on signs as follows. Zero leaves $(s,\mathit{par},\mathit{dir})$ unchanged and outputs zero. A positive sign, when reading a character, changes the parity to true and outputs zero if $\mathit{dbl}$ is true and parity is false; otherwise it sets parity to false, direction to true, and outputs positive. For a positive sign not reading a character, if direction is true it leaves the triple unchanged and outputs zero when $\mathit{last}$ is true, and otherwise increments $s$, sets parity to true and direction to false, and outputs zero; if direction is false it sets parity to false and direction to true and outputs positive. A negative sign, when reading a character, sets parity to false and outputs zero if $\mathit{dbl}$ is true and parity is true; otherwise it sets parity to true, direction to false, and outputs negative. For a negative sign not reading a character, if direction is true it sets parity to true, direction to false, and outputs negative; if direction is false and $\mathit{first}$ is true it leaves the triple unchanged and outputs zero; otherwise it decrements $s$, sets parity to false and direction to true, and outputs zero.
